model_output.suggested_action: Open dispute case, verify transaction logs, initiate refund within 24-48 hours

model_output.suggested_action: Review the account ledger to confirm the balance never went negative and reverse the fee if it was applied in error

model_output.suggested_action: Request the customer's receipt or order confirmation, open a formal dispute case with the merchant, and inform the customer of the dispute timeline
model_output.response: According to our Dispute & Refund Resolution Policy, when a charged amount does not match your receipt we will ask you to provide the receipt or order confirmation and then open a formal dispute case with the merchant. We will keep you updated on the progress of the dispute.

model_output.suggested_action: Open a dispute case, verify transaction logs, and reverse the duplicate charge
model_output.response: Based on our Billing & Fees Policy, fees applied in error must be reversed after verification. We will review your monthly subscription billing for this cycle, confirm the duplicate charge, and issue a refund accordingly.

model_output.suggested_action: Verify the payment posting date against the statement due date and, if the payment was posted after the due date, explain the interest accrual per policy; if posted on time, adjust the interest charge.
model_output.response: According to our Interest & Credit Policy, interest is not charged when the full statement balance is paid by the due date shown on the most recent statement. If a payment posts after the due date—even by one day—interest begins accruing from the transaction date. We will check the posting date of your payment and correct any interest charge if it was posted on time.

model_output.suggested_action: Provide step-by-step instructions for updating mailing address via online portal or phone support
model_output.response: You can update your mailing address by logging into online banking, selecting "Profile" > "Personal Details", and editing the address field. Alternatively, you may call our customer service line at 1‑800‑XXX‑XXXX to have a representative update it for you.

model_output.suggested_action: Provide fee waiver criteria and answer the customer’s question
model_output.response: According to our Billing & Fees Policy, the monthly maintenance fee is waived when you maintain a minimum daily balance of $1,500, or if you receive $500 or more in direct deposits each month. If either condition is met, the fee will not be applied.

model_output.suggested_action: Verify customer identity, confirm closure request, and initiate account closure process per policy
model_output.response: We can help you close your savings account. Please confirm your identity and we will guide you through the required steps to complete the closure.

model_output.suggested_action: Collect legal documentation (marriage certificate, court order, or updated government ID) and process the name change request
model_output.response: According to our Account Services Policy, we can update the name on your account and reissue cards once we receive legal documentation such as your marriage certificate, a court order, or an updated government ID. Please submit a copy of the required document through our secure portal or at a branch, and we will verify it and complete the name change for you.

model_output.suggested_action: Verify the account's average balance over the past three months and monthly qualifying direct deposits against the Premium Tier Upgrade criteria
model_output.response: According to our Premium Tier Upgrade policy, an account qualifies for the upgrade if it maintains an average balance of $10,000 or more over the trailing three months, or receives $2,000 or more in qualifying direct deposits each month. If your account meets either of these thresholds, you are eligible for the premium tier, which waives most standard fees.

model_output.suggested_action: Temporarily secure the account, verify the customer's identity, and investigate the suspicious login activity
model_output.response: We’ve received your report of suspicious login attempts from an unfamiliar country. Our security team will review the activity, temporarily protect your account, and contact you to verify your identity. Please refrain from sharing personal information in any unsolicited communications.

model_output.suggested_action: Advise the customer not to respond or click any links, report the message to the Fraud Team, monitor the account for the next 30 days, and if any sensitive information was shared, flag the account for enhanced monitoring and reset credentials immediately
model_output.response: Our Phishing & Social Engineering Response Policy states that the bank never asks customers to confirm a PIN, full card number, or online banking password via text, email, or unsolicited phone call. Any such request should be treated as fraudulent. Please do not reply to the message or click any links. Report the text to our Fraud Team, and monitor your account for any unusual activity over the next 30 days. If you have already shared any sensitive information, we will flag your account for enhanced monitoring and reset your credentials right away.

model_output.suggested_action: Verify merchant descriptor data, freeze the card immediately, open a fraud case, and issue provisional credit per dispute timelines

model_output.suggested_action: Report the call to the Fraud Team, flag the account for enhanced monitoring, and reset any credentials if sensitive data was disclosed. Advise the customer to monitor the account for the next 30 days.
